attributes.action: Sack Thomas Tuchel before the 3rd Place game v France
attributes.additional_details: The England Team represents our Country. At long last, our Supporters are now proud of the team, loyal, and well behaved. We have one of the best football leagues in the world - The Premiership. We have a marvellously rich footballing heritage. We invented the game, codified it, spread it across the globe, and were the first nation to play it professionally. We long for a major trophy. Unfortunately, this will not happen under Thomas Tuchel. Before the France game, he must be replaced.
attributes.background: England just lost a World Cup semi-final game against Argentina, and in my view this was totally down to Thomas Tuchel's negative tactics. This cannot be repeated at the Euros in '28. BEFORE the 3rd place play-off game, Tuchel must go. For one match, Harry Kane can pick the team
